messages.subject: Analisis of waking time only
parts:
Hello Vincent, 

I am working with Actigraph and GENEActiv data using your package (amazing).
I was thinking to analyse myself the generated raw output (old school). However I think now it will not be necesarry.

I am analyzing only waking hours, from 6:00 to 24:00 (in some cohorts participants did not used the accelerometer at night or used it but we are not interested in analysing sleep just yet) I set the qwindow to c(6,24). In the results I get also information for 0,6, 0.24 and so on. How can I restrict my analysis to be from 6:00 to 24:00 in all participants? Will all the summary variables be calculated to only that time interval? 

Thank you for your work¡¡

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Analisis of waking time only
parts:
Hello Garbiela,

This is not possible at the moment. When you specify qwindow = c(6, 24) GGIR willoutput results for time segments: 0-6, 6-24, and 0-24. I designed it like this assuming that users most often just want all variables and will delete the columns they are not interested in.

Best wishes,
Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees
Independent consultant
https://accelting.com/
